---
title: "Engine recipes & quickstart"
---

This book is the long-form, measured companion to the engine's short,
copy-paste task references. Those live — readable and compile-tested, in both
Rust and Python — in the engine **Guide**: the
[Getting Started](https://f-inverse.github.io/jammi-ai/quickstart-python.html)
quickstart and the
[How-To Guides](https://f-inverse.github.io/jammi-ai/cookbook-recipes.html). Their
runnable scripts ship in the `jammi-ai` repo under `cookbook/recipes/` and
`cookbook/quickstart/`, exercised by the engine's `cookbook.yml` workflow and the
`it/cookbook.rs` integration test.

Where the Guide's How-To Guides are the minimal "how do I call this verb"
reference, this book *explains* each primitive end-to-end — one recipe = one
equation = one line of the GNN canon, executed against a committed golden.

The links below point at the in-repo runnable sources on GitHub: Quarto does not
follow file links above the book's project root, and the recipes deliberately
stay outside it (engine-owned, not part of the rendered book).

## 5-minute quickstart

A fresh user from `pip install jammi-ai` to a vector query in five minutes.

- [Quickstart overview](https://github.com/f-inverse/jammi-ai/tree/main/cookbook/quickstart)
- [1 · Install](https://github.com/f-inverse/jammi-ai/blob/main/cookbook/quickstart/01_install.md)
- [2 · Connect](https://github.com/f-inverse/jammi-ai/blob/main/cookbook/quickstart/02_connect.md)
- [3 · Register a source](https://github.com/f-inverse/jammi-ai/blob/main/cookbook/quickstart/03_register_source.md)
- [4 · Generate embeddings + search](https://github.com/f-inverse/jammi-ai/blob/main/cookbook/quickstart/04_vector_search.md)
- End-to-end script: [`quickstart.py`](https://github.com/f-inverse/jammi-ai/blob/main/cookbook/quickstart/quickstart.py)
